messages:
mira (docs): Heads-up: the Generate streaming example on the API ref shows SSE frames as bare tokens (e.g. `data: token`) but our runtime emits JSON objects per frame: `data: {\"type\": \"token\", \"delta\": \"...\"}`. Customers and SDKs are parsing incorrectly and we got a bug report.

alan (eng-runtime): Yep that change landed in the streaming serializer last quarter to support richer events (type, index, final). Runtime never returned raw token lines anymore. We should make docs examples match exactly.

mira (docs): Current docs snippet (simplified) shows: 
```
event: message
data: hello

event: message
data: world
```
Which led users to implement naive parsers. Proposing to replace with an exact SSE example: 
```
event: message
data: {"type":"token","delta":"hello"}

event: message
data: {"type":"token","delta":" world"}
event: done
data: {"type":"done","request_id":"req_123"}
```
And add a short note: "Each SSE `data:` line is a JSON object. Do not assume plain text tokens."

rachel (sdk-go): Thanks — Go SDK had a small parser expecting raw token strings for the streaming helper. I'll update it to json.Unmarshal each data line and handle both legacy raw token strings (trim + string) and the object form. Will include unit tests with both shapes.

stream-bot: Automation: created issue docs#1122 (Align SSE examples) and sdk-go#221 (stream parser tolerant to JSON frames).

mira (docs): I'll open a docs PR to update the Generate and Chat streaming examples, plus the quickstart streaming guide. Also add a migration note: "If you implemented a custom SSE parser, ensure you parse JSON per-line."

alan (eng-runtime): No runtime change required. We intentionally changed event granularity to support tooling. If anyone sees loads of errors after the docs update, we can add an example proxy snippet, but prefer docs + SDK sync first.

rachel (sdk-go): Pushed a tiny patch to sdk-go#221, added tests that feed both `data: hello` and `data: {"type":"token","delta":"hello"}` into the stream handler. Local CI green, opening PR now.

mira (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1010 (CI: docs-lint ✔, link-check pending). Included SSE blocks and a curl + netcat example showing how to parse frames.

stream-bot: PRs opened: docs#1010, sdk-go#222. CI: docs-lint ✅, sdk unit-tests ⏳.

alan (eng-runtime): Lgtm on the examples, thanks. After merge, I'll scan #support for any lingering parser breakage.

rachel (sdk-go): Merged sdk-go PR and cut patch release 0.9.5 that tolerates both frame formats. Added changelog entry and a snippet showing how to decode in Go.

mira (docs): Docs PR merged and deployed to staging. I also added a short note linking to the SDK patch for convenience. Closing thread; ping me if you see any old docs fragments. :mag:
